text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, wanna stop by somewhere before 
heading home? We're already right by the 
station anyway~."

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pandora-chan! Nice timing♪ I'm about 
to go grab that trending parfait, wanna 
come?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: N-Nah, I'll pass today!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to head out with Trainer! —Just 
the two of us♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good! ...Now then, what should I 
do first~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Wondering why she had turned down the 
invitation, I followed along with her as 
told..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Hey, let's do that thing! That 
thing!
choice_data_list: Could that be... a swan boat?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, the breeze feels so nice~~♪ This is 
actually pretty great♡
choice_data_list: H-Hey, could you help row too?!
H-Hey, could you help row too?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? If I pedal, we'd go way too fast☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Here, you can have my frappe♡ Go for 
it, do your best~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious♡ Hey, hey, let me have a 
bite of that next♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, take out the bell peppers! And put in 
lots of shrimp♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Say ahh♡
choice_data_list:
I split it onto small plates, so eat from 
those!

text_block_list.name: Photo Sticker Booth Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Please select a pose! ...Pair Mode! Show 
off your bond with a pose♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, there's a tiara among the props! I'm 
gonna put this on♡ And you wear that hat!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look, that knight-like one! Consider him 
my exclusive personal knight♡

text_block_list.name: Photo Sticker Booth Voice
text_block_list.text:
"—Next, let's both make a big heart pose 
together~♡ Ready~? 3, 2, 1... Click!☆"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a tiny bit further in! Just a tiny 
tap! Yeah, right there, right there!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Ah~ finally got it~~. I thought 
I'd never win it in my whole life!
choice_data_list: Because you keep making me do it all...

That's because you always leave everything 
to me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as they were talking like that...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Found it! That one over there! Wait... 
huh? The kitty isn't there...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right... I wonder if they're 
out of stock. Should we go ask a store 
clerk...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she really wanted the plushie we 
just won. ...Her sad voice pierces right 
through my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —No way! This is mine!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the kitty, miss! You're so 
cool, you're so good at this!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, big sis is a genius after all♪ 
You'd better appreciate me, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Phew, all done!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...It's NOT good! Not a single thing is 
good!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: You're my Trainer, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to be number one! ...So why?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"At the BBQ, and just now too... you've 
been putting me on the back burner...――"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...You idiot, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps it's because I tend to pamper 
them normally. It seems I ended up making 
them feel lonely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, I'd like her to be a 
bit more independent. But well, we can 
work on that step by step; for now—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph? Then how about your oath—or 
rather, your sincerity. You'll show it to 
me, right?
choice_data_list: Take her out for a fancy dinner.
Take her to an amusement park at night

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Soooo goooood♡ The meat's so tender... It 
melts in your mouth~~~~♡♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I felt it, I felt it! I felt it 
soooo much♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Bringing me to a place like this proves 
just how much I mean to you~♡
choice_data_list: I feel like that's a bit misleading...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Fuhehe♪ All goooone! If I do my best in 
the race, take me here again, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The lights are sooooo pretty♡ It's crazy 
cute♡♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hmmmmmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's still missing just a 
teeny-tiny bit. ...Like the excitement and 
the heart-throbs! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So bring me here again next time! If you 
do, I'll forgive you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, just the two of us, of course♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the word "sincerity," I think 
about what should be done. ...In the end, 
keeping it simple is the best way—
choice_data_list: Got it, let's draw up a contract!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Usually, this is where you'd go 
for a fancy dinner, or some kind of 
present...
choice_data_list:
Now that it's decided, I have to get back 
to the academy right away!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Our date isn't over yet! Don't you 
dare just walk off, you straight-laced 
idiot Trainer!
